text: Bangladesh Elections: Watch - Inside BNP VS Jamaat Clash In Most Important Polls In DecadesBangladesh Elections: Watch - Inside BNP VS Jamaat Clash In Most Important Polls In Decades Bangladesh's high-stakes Feb 12 polls erupt in BNP-Jamaat clashes across Kushtia, Comilla with 11 injured in campaign violence & mutual rigging complaints on eve of voting. Tarique Rahman-led BNP (44% vote share) vs Shafiqur Rahman Jamaat alliance (43.9%) in razor-thin race per IRI survey amid 75 competitive seats post-Hasina ouster. 127M voters decide the BNP comeback or Islamist surge.
